Test: TC-2865 — Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Read only mode when box is archived
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-34 Box Module - Board - Basic operations
Labels: can_be_automated, rocksolid, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Home and mark Show archived box in View dropdown
   Expected: Show archived box is marked. Archived boxes are visible
2. Navigate to Board module of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-2865 Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Read only mode when box is archived
   Expected: Board module is successfully loaded and displayed.
3. Click on timeline and add new marker.
   Expected: User cannot add new marker, option is not displaying.
4. Hover over the Export button.
   Expected: Export Button is active. A tooltip appears with text: Export
5. Click on Export button.
   Expected: Export data modal dialog is displayed.

Default file type is selected as: Export to image (PDF)

There is active Export button.
6. Click on Export button. 

After the export is finished successfully close the dialog by clicking on X button.
   Expected: PDF file is successfully exported.

Export data dialog is closed after clicking on X button.
7. Click-right on Interation and change status of subbox.
   Expected: User cannot change status of subbox, option is not displaying.
8. Click-right on Interation and change Task period alignment of subbox.
   Expected: User cannot change Task period alignment of subbox, option is not displaying.
9. Click on ellipsis button (three dots) and change status of subbox.
   Expected: User cannot change status of subbox, option is unavailable
10. Click on ellipsis button (three dots) -> edit and change Task period alignment of subbox.
   Expected: User cannot change Task period alignment of subbox, option is unavailable
11. Double-click on task summary and change its name.
   Expected: User cannot change task summary name, edition field in unavailable.
12. Create dependency between taskName1 and taskName2.
   Data: taskName1: TestTask1
taskName2: TestTask3
   Expected: User cannot create dependency between tasks, option is unavailable.
13. Move task from backlog to board.
   Data: taskName: TestTask2
   Expected: User cannot move task from backlog to board.
14. Move task from board to backlog.
   Data: taskName: TestTask1
   Expected: User cannot move task from board to backlog.
15. Add new task using '+' button.
   Expected: User cannot add new task, '+' button is not displaying.
16. Allocate new team in boxName.
   Expected: User cannot allocate new team, Allocate team button is not displaying.
